name: Core UI System
meaning: Self-contained design system. Themes hold color and font primitives. Components read semantic tokens, type roles, and space roles. Not Tabler and not RHDS.

principles.title: Stack
principles.statement: The stack owns vertical rhythm. Headings and paragraphs have no margin.

principles.title: Role
principles.statement: One role, one job. Type has six sizes. A page does not add a seventh.

principles.title: Native
principles.statement: Use the native element that matches the job. A table compares rows. A button commits. A link navigates.

principles.title: Intent
principles.statement: An intent is not a color. Submit is not a fill. Status is not an action.

principles.title: Boundary
principles.statement: Components read semantic tokens from this framework. They do not read another framework's tokens.

controls.purpose: Commit the action named on the label.
controls.whenNot: Do not use for navigation. A link navigates.
Do not use as the only action on a form.

controls.purpose: Collect a single line of text.
controls.whenNot: Do not use for a choice among known options. Use tabs or a select.

controls.purpose: Switch among peer views in the same section.
controls.whenNot: Do not use tabs to navigate to another page.

controls.purpose: Ask for a decision that blocks the page.
controls.whenNot: Do not use for content the reader can scroll past.

controls.purpose: Show supporting detail beside the page.
controls.whenNot: Do not use a drawer for a yes or no decision. Use a dialog.

controls.purpose: Group a title and its content on a raised surface.
Compare rows that share the same columns. Text is left. Numbers are right, in tabular figures.
controls.whenNot: Do not use a table for a single metric. Do not rebuild the rows as a grid of divs.

controls.purpose: Name a status. Color is the status role, not an action.
controls.whenNot: Do not use a chip as a button.

controls.purpose: State a condition in a bar across the page. Color is the status role, not an action.
controls.whenNot: Do not use an alert for a decision that blocks the page. Use a dialog.
